title: MEMBERSHIP
description: Your membership has a direct impact and supports a vibrant community of emerging artists and photographers of all levels. With your gift, we can continue offering an array of resources and activities including year-round education, artists' lectures, and photography exhibitions.
seoDescription: Information about the Penumbra Foundation membership programs, including the rates and benefits of membership.

nodes.html:
INDIVIDUAl Member

Join a growing community of artists and creatives. With Individual Membership, enjoy a wide range of benefits, including discounts on workshops, access to exclusive member events & open calls, and much more.

EDUCATOR

For individuals employed by an accredited academic or arts institution—enjoy all of the same benefits as our Individual tier at a discounted rate.

PRO STUDIO

Pro Studio membership offers exclusive discounts on renting our northlight Highlight Studio—ideal for commercial and studio photographers.

STUDENT Member

Designed for students enrolled in accredited academic or arts institutions, our Student Membership provides access to Open Studios, discounted film processing, and all the benefits of our Individual tier at a student-friendly rate.

PROFESSIONAL

Take your support to the next level with Professional Membership. Receive premium perks, including 20% off workshops, a complimentary tintype session, and more.

DUAL MEMBERSHIP

Save on membership by signing up with a friend. Our Dual Membership unlocks access to the same benefits as our Individual tier, but for two.

PATRON

Support our programming at the highest level with Patron Membership.

Patron members receive invitations to Penumbra Advisory and Executive Board events and private programs with artists and curators, along with all of the benefits included in our Professional and Pro Studio tiers.

Gift a Membership

Gift a Penumbra Membership to a friend or loved one!

Membership is a non-refundable, tax-deductible contribution that keeps our community thriving, sustains our education and public programs, and supports our operational costs. For questions, please contact membership@penumbrafoundation.org
